'''Veld''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was an agent of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] and at one point in the war served on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />
